# Task ID: 9
# Title: Enhance UI for Plan Display and Control
# Status: pending
# Dependencies: 6, 8
# Priority: medium
# Description: Extend the Tauri UI to display the plan generated by the PlanManager and provide controls for managing plan execution.
# Details:
1. Create Tauri commands for plan management:
```rust
#[tauri::command]
async fn generate_plan(goal: String, state: tauri::State<'_, AppState>) -> Result<Plan, String> {
    let mut plan_manager = state.plan_manager.lock().await;
    plan_manager.generate_plan(&goal).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn execute_plan(state: tauri::State<'_, AppState>) -> Result<Plan, String> {
    let mut plan_manager = state.plan_manager.lock().await;
    plan_manager.execute_current_plan().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn get_current_plan(state: tauri::State<'_, AppState>) -> Result<Option<Plan>, String> {
    let plan_manager = state.plan_manager.lock().await;
    Ok(plan_manager.get_current_plan().cloned())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn cancel_plan(state: tauri::State<'_, AppState>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut plan_manager = state.plan_manager.lock().await;
    plan_manager.cancel_current_plan();
    Ok(())
}
```

2. Update the `AppState` struct to include the PlanManager:
```rust
struct AppState {
    macos_agent: Mutex<MacOSInteractionAgent>,
    plan_manager: Mutex<PlanManager>
}
```

3. Initialize the PlanManager in the main function:
```rust
fn main() {
    // ... existing code ...
    
    let plan_manager = PlanManager::new(create_llm_interface(&llm_config));
    plan_manager.register_agent(Box::new(agent.clone()));
    
    let app_state = AppState {
        macos_agent: Mutex::new(agent),
        plan_manager: Mutex::new(plan_manager)
    };
    
    // ... rest of main function ...
}
```

4. Enhance the frontend UI to include:
   - A section to display the current plan and its steps
   - Visual indicators for step status (pending, in-progress, completed, failed)
   - Buttons to generate a plan, execute a plan, and cancel a plan
   - A detailed view for the current step being executed
   - Real-time updates as steps are completed

# Test Strategy:
Test the Tauri commands with simple plans. Verify that the UI correctly displays the plan and updates as steps are completed. Test the cancel functionality. Test with plans of varying complexity. Ensure the UI remains responsive during plan execution.
